scripts.dev:
node -e "console.log('
  GLC Next.js (Webpack) → http://127.0.0.1:3040/
  Chunk/HMR errors → npm run dev:fresh | Try Turbopack → npm run dev:turbo
')" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run clean && node -e "console.log('\n  GLC Next.js → http://127.0.0.1:3040/\n')" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
scripts.dev:turbo: node -e "console.log('\n  Turbopack dev (alternate bundler if Webpack HMR breaks)\n')" && next dev --turbopack -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3040
